result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`. The query now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and latest purchase-order queries use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. I added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` case that reproduces your example, and a status parameter on the test helper that defaults to `SENT`.
- **Result:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I did not run the full suite.

Nothing is committed.
